stoneveil.brief: Jacob: a cave species that looks like Shaak Ti and Plo Koon fused, living for blood rituals, like WoW's blood trolls. Mixed into an original race, never a copy.

1-mask.look: bone and bronze breathing mask with round red goggles, banded head-tails over the shoulders, small tusks

2-horns.look: tall curved hollow horns, red and white striped face, banded head-tails, narrow bone mouth guard

3-troll.look: feral and hunched, glowing red ritual scars, long ears, big tusks, short head-tails, leather breathing muzzle

thundercoast.brief: Jacob: an ancient Nautolan tribe under the sea, very clever, made into fishmen with machines and DNA changes, who see everyone above the water as beneath them. Mixed into an original race, never a copy.

1-tentacles.look: teal skin, black eyes, long head tentacles, slim diving harness; closest to a plain Nautolan

2-spliced.look: gene-spliced shark fishman: fin crest, gills, scales, webbed claws, forearm fin blades, surgical seams

3-diver.look: tentacled head in a water-filled glass helmet, chest pump, pressure plates, fin thrusters
